title: Defer in a loop
hints: Deferred calls run when the function returns, not at the end of a loop iteration. Every file stays open until TotalSize finishes, so with thousands of files you run out of file handles.
Move the body of the loop into its own function, so the defer runs at the end of each file.
func size(open Opener, name string) (int, error) { f, err := open(name); if err != nil { return 0, err }; defer f.Close(); b, err := io.ReadAll(f); return len(b), err }  — and call it from the loop.
